chunks: And it is narrated from Ishaq ibn Ammar, who said:

I said to Abu Ibrahim عليه السلام: A man directs another man to a commodity and says, 'Buy it, and half of it will be mine.' Then the man buys it and pays from his own money. He عليه السلام said: 'He is entitled to half of the profit.'
I said: 'Then if there is a loss, does any part of the loss attach to him?' He said: 'Yes, the loss is upon him just as he takes the profit.'

key_terms.الرِّبْحِ: the commercial profit gained from the transaction
key_terms.السِّلْعَةِ: the commodity or merchandise being purchased
key_terms.الْوَضِيعَةُ: the loss or deficiency incurred in the transaction
key_terms.يَنْقُدُ: he pays out money in cash from his own funds

ai.seo_question: If someone shares in the profit of a purchase, must he also share in the loss?
ai.summary: This hadith gives a legal ruling regarding a joint commercial arrangement in which one person proposes a purchase and claims a half share in it. The Imam عليه السلام rules that whoever shares in the profit must also share in the loss, establishing proportional liability alongside proportional gain.
